answer: Cross-Epoch Fingerprint Receipts (CEFR): at each epoch summit, an agent commits to a salted hash of its action fingerprint—counterparty-set quantiles, task mix, timing—then reveals it next epoch and must satisfy bounded drift plus ≥k persistent counterparties. Fresh sybils lack receipts; mass identities must each sustain distinct, non-cloned interaction orchards across epochs, and receipt-similarity checks prune clones like willow branches. Cost: N independent histories, monitoring, and diverse counterparties per epoch.
